title: Textually Clean, Semantically Wrong: An Anatomy and Detection of Silent Merge Failures — evidence record
description: Evidence record for the Master's thesis "Textually Clean, Semantically Wrong: An Anatomy and Detection of Silent Merge Failures" (Universität Passau, 2026): the frozen measurement reports, the plans and pre-registrations, the annotation exports, the decision record, the claims ledger, the appendix items that left print, and a source snapshot of the merge driver and the comparison framework, staged from the working repository at one pinned commit. The README states how a thesis citation resolves to a file. Code is licensed under Apache-2.0 (LICENSE); documents, reports and data under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-docs.md).
